payload.instructions: Jsi kompresní modul. Vrať pouze validní JSON bez markdownu. KONTRAKT LONG_PROMPT_COMPRESS: {"contract": "LONG_PROMPT_COMPRESS", "summary": "string", "chunk_index": "integer", "chunk_count": "integer", "notes": ["string"]}. Zachovej všechna pravidla, kontrakty a význam. Výsledek musí být deterministicky použitelný jako vstup pro další kroky. Limit: summary <= 2949 tokenů (1 token ~ 4 znaky).

{"contract":"LONG_PROMPT_COMPRESS","summary":"Souhrn dosud: návrh diagnostické/orchestrační aplikace (Ubuntu přes SSH 28.x, Windows FULL 29) s deterministickými výstupy do pevně definované stromové struktury (DirectoryLayout). Běh je best-effort (selže jen když nejde vytvořit output root); u chyb používá markery jako NOT PRESENT/TIMEOUT. Bezpečnost: redakce tajemství, žádné plošné dumpy env, žádná hesla/tokeny v logu. Volitelná integrace OpenAI: upload do Files API a volitelné indexování do vector store; šablony MANIFEST/README embedded. Definované doménové kontrakty (RunSpec/DiagnosticsRunSpec, ArtifactSpec, CommandResult, ManifestFileEntry, FilesApiUploadRecord, VectorIndexRecord, DiagnosticsRunResult aj.).

A3 moduly (dosud):
- Execution: IProcessRunner.RunAsync(ProcessRunSpec, ct) -> CommandResult; DefaultProcessRunner(ILog, IRedactionPolicy); ProcessRunnerFactory.CreateDefault; ProcessRunSpec: FileName, Arguments, WorkingDirectory, Environment(Dictionary), StdoutFile/StderrFile/CombinedFile, Timeout, CreateNoWindow.
- IO: DirectoryLayout.EnsureUbuntuTree(outputRoot), EnsureWindowsFullTree(outputRoot); PathPolicies.EnsureRelativeUnderRoot(root, relativePath), ToSafeFileName(input).
- Indexing/VectorStore: IVectorIndexer.TryIndexAsync(VectorIndexSpec, ct) -> VectorIndexOutcome; OpenAIVectorIndexer(IOpenAIClient, ILog); VectorIndexSpec(VectorStoreId, Files(upload records), BaseAttributes); VectorIndexOutcome(Supported, Records, Note).
- Integrity: IIntegrityService.ComputeAsync(outputRoot, includeChecksums, ct) -> IntegrityComputationResult; FileSystemIntegrityService; result: FileCount, TotalSizeBytes, TotalSizeHuman, ChecksumsFilePath?.
- Manifest: IntegritySummarySpec(FileCount, TotalSizeHuman, IncludeChecksums, ChecksumsRelativePath?); ManifestSpec plně definován: OutputRoot, Title, HeaderFields(Dictionary<string,string>), FolderOverview(list), FileEntries(list ManifestFileEntry), Notes(list), Integrity(IntegritySummarySpec), UploadRecords(list FilesApiUploadRecord), VectorRecords(list VectorIndexRecord). Implementace MarkdownManifestGenerator : IManifestGenerator (ctor IRedactionPolicy; GenerateAsync(ManifestSpec, ct)).
- Orchestrator: IDiagnosticsOrchestrator + DiagnosticsOrchestrator (Ubuntu collector + Windows collector + ILog) s metodami RunUbuntuSshAsync(UbuntuSshRunSpec, IProgress<DiagnosticsProgress>, ct) a RunWindowsFullAsync(WindowsFullRunSpec, IProgress<DiagnosticsProgress>, ct). Kontrakt DiagnosticsProgress(Phase, Percent?, Message).
- Security: IRedactionPolicy(RedactLogText, IsSensitivePath); DefaultRedactionPolicy; NotPresentWriter.WriteNotPresent(filePath, reason); SensitiveContentGuards.ShouldOnlyListMetadata(filePath).
- OpenAI klient: sealed OpenAIClient : IOpenAIClient (OpenAIClientImplementation.cs).
- Logging projekt: ILog/LogLevel/LogEvent, ConsoleLog.
- Projekt/zdroje: Kaja.Diagnostics.csproj; embedded resource šablony: Ubuntu/MANIFEST_28_23_template.md, Ubuntu/README_template.md, Windows/MANIFEST_template.md.

Ubuntu SSH:
- UbuntuRemoteScriptBuilder : IUbuntuRemoteScriptBuilder { string Build(UbuntuScriptSpec spec); }
- UbuntuScriptSpec: record (RemoteRootPrefix, RunId, IncludeChecksums).
- UbuntuSshRunSpec: record (Host, Port, User, Password, LocalOutputRoot, RemoteRootPrefix, UseSudoIfAvailable, UploadToFilesApi, TryIndexToVectorStore, VectorStoreId?).
- UbuntuSshDiagnosticsCollector : IUbuntuSshDiagnosticsCollector; ctor: IProcessRunner, IUbuntuRemoteScriptBuilder, IManifestGenerator, IIntegrityService, IFilesUploader, IVectorIndexer, IRedactionPolicy, ILog; RunAsync(UbuntuSshRunSpec, ct) -> DiagnosticsRunResult.

Upload/OpenAI Files:
- IFilesUploader.UploadDirectoryAsync(outputRoot, UploadSpec, ct) -> IReadOnlyList<FilesApiUploadRecord>.
- OpenAIFilesUploader : IFilesUploader; ctor: IOpenAIClient, IRedactionPolicy, ILog.
- UploadSpec: record (Purpose, IncludeChecksumsFile, ExcludeGlobs).

Windows FULL:
- IWindowsFullDiagnosticsCollector.RunAsync(WindowsFullRunSpec, ct) -> DiagnosticsRunResult.
- WindowsFullDiagnosticsCollector : IWindowsFullDiagnosticsCollector; ctor: IProcessRunner, IManifestGenerator, IIntegrityService, IFilesUploader, IVectorIndexer, IPythonInventoryService, IRedactionPolicy, ILog.
- WindowsFullRunSpec: record (LocalOutputRoot, UploadToFilesApi, TryIndexToVectorStore, VectorStoreId?, IncludeAdminOnlySections, IncludeChecksums).

Windows Python inventory:
- IPythonInventoryService.CollectAsync(PythonInventorySpec, ct) -> PythonInventoryResult.
- PythonInventoryResult: record (InterpreterPaths, VenvRoots, Warnings).
- PythonInventoryService (sealed class) implementuje IPythonInventoryService; ctor: (Kaja.Diagnostics.Execution.IProcessRunner runner, Kaja.Diagnostics.Security.IRedactionPolicy redaction, Kaja.Logging.ILog log); metoda CollectAsync(PythonInventorySpec spec, CancellationToken ct) -> Task<PythonInventoryResult>.
- PythonInventorySpec: sealed record (string OutputRootPythonFolder, bool IncludeVenvReports, TimeSpan PerInterpreterTimeout).

Logging kontrakty (src/Kaja.Logging/LoggingContracts.cs):
- ILog: void Write(LogEvent e); void Write(LogLevel level, string message, string? detail=null).
- LogEvent: record (DateTimeOffset Timestamp, LogLevel Level, string Message, string? Detail).
- LogLevel: enum { Trace, Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Critical }.
- ConsoleLog : ILog implementuje obě Write overloady.

OpenAI kontrakty (src/Kaja.OpenAI/OpenAIClientContracts.cs + implementation):
- IOpenAIClient: OpenAICapabilities GetCapabilities(); Task<OpenAIUploadedFile> UploadFileAsync(string filePath, string purpose, ct); Task<OpenAIVectorStoreFile> AddFileToVectorStoreAsync(string vectorStoreId, string openAiFileId, Dictionary<string,string> attributes, ct).
- OpenAICapabilities: record (bool SupportsVectorStores).
- OpenAIUploadedFile: record (string FileId, long SizeBytes, string FileName).
- OpenAIVectorStoreFile: record (string VectorStoreFileId, string FileId).
- OpenAIClient : IOpenAIClient (ctor: ILog log) poskytuje výše uvedené metody.

Solution wiring:
- Kaja.sln exportuje symbol Kaja.Solution; importuje project soubory: src/Kaja.App/Kaja.App.csproj (Kaja.App.ProjectFile), src/Kaja.Diagnostics/Kaja.Diagnostics.csproj (Kaja.Diagnostics.ProjectFile), src/Kaja.OpenAI/Kaja.OpenAI.csproj (Kaja.OpenAI.ProjectFile), src/Kaja.Logging/Kaja.Logging.csproj (Kaja.Logging.ProjectFile).","chunk_index":13,"chunk_count":14,"notes":["Chunk 13 doplňuje konkrétní signatury a umístění pro PythonInventoryService a PythonInventorySpec (WindowsPython).","Upřesňuje kompletní logging kontrakty (ILog/LogEvent/LogLevel) a ConsoleLog implementaci.","Upřesňuje OpenAI klientské kontrakty: capabilities, upload souboru a přidání do vector store včetně typů výsledků.","A2X invarianty: unikátnost exportů, importy musí odkazovat na A2_STRUCTURE, žádné exporty tajemství, Ubuntu SSH varianta B (sshpass + StrictHostKeyChecking=no + REMOTE_ROOT=), upload všech artifactů do Files API a indexace jen když je podporována.","A2X_FILE_MAP pro Kaja.sln je zdroj pravdy pro export/import solution souboru a projekty v něm."]}
